findings.quote: Kailangan ang anyong ng para sa higit sa isang tao.
findings.problem: The solution ties the ng form to having more than one person. The ng form is chosen by the pronoun's role (here, the doer of the action), and ng pronouns such as niya also refer to one person.

checked: Checked conditions. Singular they limits, group nouns as unit versus members, and following a stated rule in the task are covered. The Filipino roles depend on the sentence, and siya does not change with gender.

accuracy_concerns.quote: Kailangan ang anyong ng para sa higit sa isang tao.
accuracy_concerns.concern: This sentence reads as if the ng form is needed because more than one person is involved. The ng form (nila) is chosen because the pronoun is the doer; ng pronouns also refer to one person.
